description_en: Adds multiple elastic IP addresses (EIPs) to an Internet Shared Bandwidth instance
description_zh: 调用AddCommonBandwidthPackageIps接口批量添加EIP到共享带宽中
kebab_example: aliyun vpc add-common-bandwidth-package-ips --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --bandwidth-package-id cbwp-2ze2ic1xd2qeqasdf0000 --ip-instance-ids eip-2zeerraiwb7uqwed0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddCommonBandwidthPackageIps

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Internet Shared Bandwidth instance. 

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/448570.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
共享带宽所在的地域ID。 

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/448570.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the Internet Shared Bandwidth instance
parameters.name: bandwidth_package_id

parameters.help_en: The IP type. Set the value to EIP, which specifies that EIPs are added to the Internet Shared Bandwidth instance
parameters.help_zh: IP类型。取值：EIP，表示将EIP添加至共享带宽
parameters.name: ip_type

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The list of EIP instance IDs to be added.

You can add up to 10 EIP instance IDs at a time
parameters.help_zh:
待添加的EIP实例ID列表。

一次最多支持添加10个EIP实例ID
parameters.name: ip_instance_ids
